replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, especially when problems feel abstract or time-pressured. My low extraversion and moderate neuroticism make me introspective, so I often overthink equations, which can trigger anxiety even when I know the concepts.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I've used AI tools like chatbots to check solutions and explain steps, which helped clarify confusing topics. It was useful for quick feedback, but I still prefer working through problems manually to truly internalize the logic.

replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA reduces data dimensionality by finding directions of maximum variance.
